title: 雪泥
subtitle: 自由画布 · 文字创作工作台

timestampSegments.zh: 有时候，你只是突然想到一个问题。

timestampSegments.en: Don’t rush to tidy it up. Put together whatever came to mind in this moment.
timestampSegments.zh: 不用急着整理。先把这一刻想到的，都放在一起。

timestampSegments.en: Drag the photo and the note in. Ali can see what you’re looking at.
timestampSegments.zh: 把照片、笔记拖进去。阿狸就能看见你正在看的东西。

timestampSegments.en: Talk about whatever comes to mind first.
Encyclopedia, essays, images appear in the chat first. Chat is the process — not the conclusion.
timestampSegments.zh: 百科、文章、图片，会先出现在对话里。聊天是过程，还不是结论。

timestampSegments.en: What you want to keep, drag back onto the canvas. Not every answer is worth keeping.
timestampSegments.zh: 真正想留住的，再拖回画布。不是每个回答，都值得留下。

timestampSegments.en: What you keep slowly becomes your material.
timestampSegments.zh: 留下来的，才慢慢变成你的材料。

timestampSegments.en: Select the pieces that matter. Let AI gather them into an essay.
timestampSegments.zh: 框选真正重要的几张。让 AI 帮你收成一篇文章。

timestampSegments.en: You can keep talking in the editor. Suggestions land in the draft — keep it if it fits, delete it if it doesn’t.
timestampSegments.zh: 写着还能继续聊。建议会出现在正文里，觉得合适，就留下；不合适，就删掉。

timestampSegments.en: From one idea, to a long-form essay.
timestampSegments.zh: 从一个想法，到一篇长文
